title.narrative: DtZ- Step Up the Fight Against Sexual Exploitation of Children (Philippines)

description.narrative: The SUFASEC programme is designed to combat SEC by working towards the following long-term impact: “Children in all of their diversity are better protected from sexual exploitation.” The long-term impact will be reached through three interlinking objectives that address different dimensions (social norms, assets/environments, and laws/policies/systems). The different stakeholder groups involved in the SUFASEC programme include: Children and youth in all their diversity, Caregivers and Communities, CSOs and CBOs, Local and national governments, Private Secto, International donors, Intergovernmental bodies, INGOs, Multilateral entities, Dutch Stakeholders, Media & Journalists

participating-org.narrative: Bidlisiw Foundation, Inc. is a social development non-governmental agency with 33 years of experiences currently operating in several cities of the Philippines, including Mandaue, Cebu, Lapulapu, Danao, Iloilo, Northern Iloilo, and Camotes Island with a strong focus on helping poor families, particularly informal settlers and families with children in need of special protection. With a total of 42 staff, and grant management capacity of approximately 940,000 Euro, Bidlisiw has extensive experiences implementing education augmentation support, alternative learning, skills and vocational training, as well as livelihood support to complete the reintegration process of the survivor. Bidlisiw has a long range of experience organising child rights groups, peer support groups and community volunteer mobilisation. Bidlisiw has also established a strong working relationship with the LGUs, government agencies, other non-government organisations, communities, and a strong ground experience working with abused and exploited children and young people particularly trafficked children, and valuable experience in working with LGBTI groups, such as BISDAK Pride, which enhances their capacity to ensure the protection and mitigation of risks when engaging with LGBTI children. Bidlisiw is also a member of the Regional and Local Interagency Committee against Trafficking and the City Development Council of Cebu City. For over 10 years, Bidlisiw has partnered with TdH NL on issues related to SEC (sexual exploitation of children) (e.g. Down to Zero and Girls Advocacy Alliance Programmes).
